'''Xat Hracken''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as the [[Combat Master]] at a [[Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. By [[3645 BBY]], Hracken had taught at the academy for many decades. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] after the disappearance of the student [[Wim Nickter]] from the academy, Hracken stayed up late one night with the student [[Mnah Ra'at]], while Ra'at practiced on the academy's combat simulator. Hracken turned off the lights in the room to test whether Ra'at could face the machine while blind.

==Biography==
Xat Hracken was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="RH" /> who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resultant [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|period of political unrest]].<ref name="Wars">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}} establishes that the [[Great Galactic War]] came to a close in [[3653 BBY]], while ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'' states that the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed lasted at least ten years. [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']] takes place eight years after the Great War, indicating that the events of the novel occur during the Cold War.</ref> It was during that [[Time/Legends|time]] Hracken became allied with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and eventually became both a [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord of the Sith]]. His service to the Empire was given as a combat instructor, one stationed at the [[Sith academy]] on the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-blanketed [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Odacer-Faustin]].<ref name="RH" /> The war effort against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was ended in [[3653 BBY]] with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> at which point the Imperial war machine chose to accelerate its output of [[Sith Warrior|Sith warriors]] and leaders, rather than decrease it.<ref name="FA">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] Hracken retained his decades-long position as combat instructor of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]], and a measure of his skill was imparted to the enrolled learners.<ref name="RH" />

Hracken survived the initial outbreak caused by Scabrous' experiment and saved Ra'at and his fellow students Hartwig, Maggs, and Kindra by blasting their attackers with Force lightning. He killed an infected Ra'at shortly after the student turned by incinerating him with Force lightning.

The surviving four Sith confronted each other over if any of them were infected. They all stripped to examine each other for infection. However, unbeknownst to all, Hracken, during the previous fight, had bitten his lip open while straining to maintain his Force lightning, and as a result, spraying infected blood got into his wound. He succumbed to the infection and killed Hartwig before being slain by Kindra.

==Personality and traits==
Hracken had a build that was more similar to that of an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] than that of a Human, with a bulky stature, broad shoulders and a bald head. He had an olive-colored face, and perpetually exhibited a scowling expression. He was intrigued by the ambition that Ra'at displayed.<ref name="RH" />

==Powers and abilities==
Aside from his many other combat skills, Hracken possessed an unbelievable mastery over [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], a talent used to decimate hordes of [[Zombie/Legends|zombies]], the power of which resulted in a fantastic and deafening explosion.<ref name="RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Joe Schreiber]] created Xat Hracken for the [[2010]]'' [[Red Harvest (novel)|Red Harvest]]'' horror novel, the prequel to ''[[Death Troopers]]'', also penned by Schreiber. ''Red Harvest'' is Hracken's first and only appearance to date.
